name: Beat Saber: Hip Hop Mixtape
summary:
Hip Hop Mixtape features a new custom environment with electrifying light shows. This music pack includes these tracks:

2Pac - All Eyez On Me (feat. Big Syke)
Nicki Minaj - Anaconda
Snoop Dogg - Gin and Juice
Eminem - Godzilla (feat. Juice WRLD)
Outkast - Hey Ya!
The Notorious B.I.G. - Hypnotize
Dr Dre - Nuthin’ But A “G” Thang
Grandmaster Flash & The Furious Five - The Message
Pop Smoke - The Woo (feat. 50 Cent, Roddy Ricch)
